newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent steady, range trading seen, NYMEX up.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent steady, range trading seen, NYMEX up.

text.p: Brent crude futures in Asia were steady on Friday with extended range trading expected, traders said.
July Brent was last traded on SIMEX at $19.48 per barrel, steady from London overnighgt which rose 24 cents.
"I think the market is pretty neutral," one broker said. He said Brent had strong support at $19.00/$19.20 and that he expected any resistance on the day around $19.60.
However, a slightly firmer NYMEX market was offering some support.
July on ACCESS was last traded at $20.99, up two cents from New York, while August was up four cents at $21.11.
"We are now heading into the weekend, so perhaps there will be more range trading before seeking direction next week," one broker said.
